author: DasBlues
body:
Hey guys and gals... so as you can see by the title people playing walls at times will take super long, like make a sky base and camp there for a good 3-4 hours.. i really dislike this in walls and i was hoping that maybe avicus could set a timer for a whole game? maybe like 45 mins - 1 hour maybe? it would be great
P.S Idk where to put this so move if needed
 Thanks :D

title: Long Games On Walls

replies.author: OriginaI
replies.body:
I just don't really like this idea,  the whole thing of walls is to get a good strategy, imagine finally getting full diamond where you don't know where the diamonds are,  crafting and going up,  and having the game end,  plus sky bases and that hard to get. Past.

If this were to be added make it 2 hours
And ps.  I've played a ton of walls games and never had a game go over 1 and a half hour
